mainEntity.name: What is Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics is a private rehab located in Barrie, Ontario, specializing in the treatment of substance, drug, and alcohol abuse.

mainEntity.name: What kind of addiction treatments does Road to Recovery Health Clinics offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics offers opioid addiction therapies such as methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian®, as well as alcohol addiction therapies, smoking cessation, and mental health treatments.

mainEntity.name: Where are the outpatient opioid detoxification clinics of Road to Recovery Health Clinics located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics operates outpatient opioid detoxification clinics in many regions across the province of Ontario.

mainEntity.name: What is the Finnish concept followed by Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics follows the Finnish concept of “SISU” which focuses on mental toughness and resilience in the face of adversity.

mainEntity.name: What kind of professionals will assist in the treatment at Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Qualified RPNs and doctors will assist in your treatment at Road to Recovery Health Clinics.

mainEntity.name: Are there any amenities available at Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Road to Recovery Health Clinics offers a variety of amenities such as evidence-based practices, yoga and meditation, individual, family and group therapy, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to be seen by a physician for opioid addiction treatment at Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: New patient intakes for opioid addiction treatment (OAT) are seen by the nurse followed by physicians on the same day that they start.

mainEntity.name: What is the screening process for Hep-C at Road to Recovery Health Clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Screening for Hep-C is available, and treatment options are available for those who test positive for the virus. This exclusive service is available in select Road to Recovery Health Clinics.

blocks.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics is a leading addiction treatment provider in Ontario, Canada. Their goal is to help a large segment of the population struggling with opioid addiction, and they have established outpatient opioid detoxification centers in various locations across the province. In addition to opioid addiction, the clinic also specializes in treating alcohol addiction, smoking cessation, and mental health services.

centre.about_html:
Road to Recovery Health Clinic is a private rehab center located in Barrie, Ontario that offers specialized treatment for individuals struggling with substance, drug, and alcohol abuse. Their mission is to help the significant portion of Ontario’s population who are dealing with opioid addiction. They provide effective treatment options such as methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian® for opioid addiction, as well as therapies for alcohol addiction, smoking cessation, and mental health treatments.

Road to Recovery Health Clinic operates outpatient opioid detoxification clinics in various regions across the province. They follow the Finnish concept of “SISU,” which means mental toughness, and their goal is to assist individuals on their journey to healing both mentally and physically.

The team at Road to Recovery Health Clinic is made up of qualified RPNs and doctors who assist in the treatment process. They have an efficient and pleasant group of healthcare professionals who provide top-notch care to patients. The clinic provides same-day appointments for new patient intakes for opioid addiction treatment (OAT), with patients first seen by a nurse and then by physicians.

In addition to their standard services, Road to Recovery Health Clinic offers screening for Hep-C and treatment options for individuals who test positive for the virus. This exclusive service is available in select Road to Recovery Health Clinics. Professional psychiatry services can also be arranged locally or virtually through CAMH and OTN.

Road to Recovery Health Clinic offers a range of specialized treatments and therapies to support individuals on their path to recovery. Their amenities include evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga and meditation, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

Overall, Road to Recovery Health Clinic is a leading provider of addiction treatment in Ontario, with a compassionate and experienced team that helps individuals find their inner strength and heal both mentally and physically.
